system.effect:
Prerequisites: Minor Gift – Fiery Core
1 AP – Standard Action
Effect: A cloud of Steam Hazards erupt in a Blast 3 centered on you; the Steam persists until the end of the encounter, or until Defog or Whirlwind are used. All targets attacking from or into the Steam receive a -3 penalty to Accuracy. All creatures in the Steam at the start of their turn that are not immune to Burns take a tick of damage.
